create_DPO: create a DPO module from a TransformerWrapper model with configurable beta and pad_id for direct preference optimization training
run_DPO_forward: run DPO forward pass with preferred and unpreferred sequences, prompt mask, and optional sequence masks to compute DPO loss
build_DPO_with_frozen_ref: build a DPO instance that deep-copies the policy model as a frozen reference model for stable log-probability baselines
test_masked_mean: test masked_mean to compute mean log-probabilities over non-masked positions with automatic mask length adjustment
review_log_prob_from_model: review log_prob_from_model_and_seq to extract per-token log probabilities from model logits given an input sequence
